title: Claude Haiku 4.5 joins the model list
summary:
Claude Haiku 4.5 joined the model list while the community brought a solo RPG and seven projects to the showcase.

Added Claude Haiku 4.5 as `claudyclaude`, with text and image input plus tool support. The model work also raised an existing model’s input limit from 10,000 to 30,000 characters and adjusted parameter handling so downstream APIs validate ranges and several models use provider temperature defaults.

codevector-2003 added AI Dungeon Master, a fantasy RPG that generates story scenes and images. Players can take suggested paths or write their own actions, with dice combat, character stats, inventory, story history and browser-based saves.

Seven projects joined the showcase, spanning editable thumbnails, API examples, image generation, an iOS Shortcut and browser-based agent tools. BeeCoder, which connects VS Code Copilot to Pollinations, also joined the vibe-coding project list.

highlights.title: Claude Haiku 4.5 added
highlights.text: Send text or images to `claudyclaude`, with tool support for workflows that need it. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claudyclaude).
